sentences.translation: for three weeks, hiroshi passed before that kafu.
i was saying coffee to mado.
there was a little cold too.
hiroshi wanted to have a umbrella.
there was a man at the counter.
everyone in niyama was playing saki.
excuse me. i'd like some coffee.
hiroshi sat down to the soba soba.
there was no one in michi.
after a while, sakisan brought me coffee.
sakisan also got to the counter.
the wolf was swollen with madness.
sakisan was a little bit soft.
yes, but the strings on the fins are beautiful. i can see them well.
"No, I'm not. Today ... I'm always busy with people, even if you're a wolf."
i was so glad that i came to nisame, but?
hiroshi was a little bit shy.
"It's a good idea because it's a good idea. But it's not all."
i have done things. and... i don't know.
sakisan didn't have anything to say.
the candy was still in the air.
miurasan, are you always so quiet?
yes, i've had a big time. but this is the place i like.
sakisan came and said nothing to me.
"Shanshukan, you were in front of me."
hiroshi was a little bit out of place.
but there was no difficult answer.
"Who am I, after all my things, I don't know."
sakisan didn't have anything to say.
but there was a warm coffee on the table.
my old lady's eyes are fine.
that was still a little shy.
but inside kafu, it was warm.
